pois.name: Puerta de Alcalá
pois.description: Francesco Sabatini's 1778 Neoclassical triumphal arch (22m), commissioned by Carlos III. The symbolic gateway between old Madrid and the eastern road to Alcalá de Henares.

pois.name: Palacio de Cibeles
pois.description: Antonio Palacios's 1919 wedding-cake Baroque-Plateresque palace (82m), now Madrid's City Hall. CentroCentro arts centre with a free rooftop terrace and belvedere.

pois.name: Parque del Buen Retiro
pois.description: Madrid's 350-acre royal garden (UNESCO 2021). The artificial lake, Crystal Palace greenhouse, and the Rose Garden make it the city's living room.

pois.name: Biblioteca Nacional
pois.description: Spain's national library (1896), with 28 million items including the Cervantes manuscripts. The museum wing opens a vault on 1,000 years of illustrated books.
